headline: William Blair downgrades Stevanato Group stock rating on 2027 outlook
summary: William Blair downgraded Stevanato Group's stock rating following an evaluation of the company's 2027 business outlook.
why: Stevanato Group manufactures drug containment and delivery systems for the pharmaceutical industry, serving as a bellwether for pharma supply chain demand.

impacts.name: Stevanato Group SpA
impacts.why: Analyst rating downgrades typically introduce negative sentiment and lower institutional demand for shares.
